release_notes: Added audience hype, catch streaks, score multipliers, miss penalties, and six-ball double-score encores.
Added spotlight balls every fifth drop for higher-risk, higher-value moments.
Added live score-route guidance showing completed notes, the next required note, and incorrect ordering.
Added concert targets, melody goals, performance ratings, stars, and standing-ovation coin rewards.
Added a physical performance board, reactive audience lighting, encore spotlights, screen pulses, richer chords, and clearer scoring feedback.
Expanded deterministic logic and scene tests for route tracking, encores, spotlight balls, ratings, and 3D presentation.
The browser smoke harness could not bind localhost under the restricted sandbox, but the full test suite and final production build completed successfully.
